movies.title: Dune
movies.synopsis: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.
movies.storyline: A mythic and emotionally charged hero's journey, Dune tells the story of Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, who must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people.

movies.title: The Batman
movies.synopsis: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues.
movies.storyline: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.synopsis: Explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.
movies.storyline: With Earth becoming uninhabitable, a former NASA pilot leaves his family behind to join a mission through a newly discovered wormhole in search of a new home for humankind.

movies.title: Peaky Blinders
movies.synopsis: A gangster family epic set in 1900s England, centering on the Shelby family and their ambitious, cunning leader Tommy.
movies.storyline: In the aftermath of the First World War, the Shelby crime family rises from the streets of Birmingham to the corridors of power, led by the calculating and haunted Thomas Shelby.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.synopsis: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb.
movies.storyline: The dramatic account of the brilliant physicist who led the Manhattan Project, the ultimate weapon it produced, and the moral reckoning that followed.

movies.title: Devil in Ohio
movies.synopsis: When a psychiatrist takes in a mysterious cult escapee, her world is turned upside down. A dark secret is lurking in the cornfields.

movies.title: The Jackal
movies.synopsis: An elusive assassin known only as the Jackal takes on a job that pulls him into a cat-and-mouse chase with a tenacious intelligence officer.

movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick
movies.synopsis: After more than thirty years of service, Pete 'Maverick' Mitchell is pulled back to train a new generation of elite pilots for a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible
movies.synopsis: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team race against time to track down a terrifying new weapon before it falls into the wrong hands.
movies.storyline: With the fate of the world at stake and dark forces from his past closing in, Ethan Hunt begins a deadly race around the globe, forced to consider that nothing matters more than his mission — not even the lives of those he cares about most.

movies.title: The Godfather
movies.synopsis: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son.

movies.title: Upgrade
movies.synopsis: After a brutal mugging leaves him paralyzed, a man accepts an experimental chip implant that lets him walk again — and hunt his attackers.

movies.title: Mr. Nobody
movies.synopsis: In 2092, the last mortal man on Earth looks back on the many lives he might have lived, each shaped by a single childhood choice.

movies.title: The Moon
movies.synopsis: An astronaut is stranded alone on the Moon after a disaster, and a former space-center director races to bring him home.

movies.title: Inception
movies.synopsis: A thief who steals secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into a CEO's mind.

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.synopsis: A computer hacker learns the shocking truth about reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.synopsis: A betrayed Roman general is sold into slavery and rises through the arena to avenge the murder of his family and his emperor.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.synopsis: Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice when the Joker unleashes chaos on Gotham.

movies.title: The Prestige
movies.synopsis: Two rival stage magicians in Victorian London engage in a bitter battle to create the ultimate illusion, at any cost.

movies.title: Dunkirk
movies.synopsis: Allied soldiers from Belgium, the British Empire and France are surrounded by the German army and evacuated during a fierce battle in World War II.

movies.title: Harry Potter
movies.synopsis: An orphaned boy discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard, and begins his first year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

movies.title: Avengers
movies.synopsis: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team to stop Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

movies.title: Her
movies.synopsis: In a near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

movies.title: Snowpiercer
movies.synopsis: In a future where a failed climate experiment has frozen the Earth, the last survivors live aboard a perpetually moving train divided by class.

movies.title: Gattaca
movies.synopsis: In a future where genetics determine destiny, a genetically inferior man assumes the identity of a superior one to pursue his dream of space travel.

movies.title: Blue Ruin
movies.synopsis: A mysterious drifter returns to his childhood home to carry out an act of vengeance, only to find himself hopelessly out of his depth.

movies.title: Children of Men
movies.synopsis: In a chaotic future where humanity has become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to safety.

movies.title: Coherence
movies.synopsis: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

movies.title: Predestination
movies.synopsis: A temporal agent embarks on a final time-travelling assignment to prevent an elusive criminal from launching an attack that kills thousands.

movies.title: The Nice Guys
movies.synopsis: In 1970s Los Angeles, a mismatched pair of private eyes investigate the apparent suicide of a fading starlet and stumble into a conspiracy.

movies.title: Dragon Ball Z
movies.synopsis: Goku and the Z Fighters defend Earth against increasingly powerful villains, from Saiyan invaders to the dreaded Cell and Majin Buu.

movies.title: Game of Thrones
movies.synopsis: Nine noble families fight for control of the lands of Westeros, while an ancient enemy returns after being dormant for millennia.

movies.title: Mr. Robot
movies.synopsis: Elliot, a brilliant but deeply troubled cybersecurity engineer, is recruited by an anarchist to join a hacker collective aiming to take down corporate America.

movies.title: Patriot
movies.synopsis: An intelligence officer takes a cover job at a Midwestern piping firm to keep Iran from going nuclear — with dark and absurd consequences.

movies.title: Person of Interest
movies.synopsis: A former CIA agent and a reclusive billionaire use a machine that predicts violent crime to save people before it happens.

movies.title: Counterpart
movies.synopsis: A lowly UN bureaucrat discovers that his agency guards a crossing into a parallel dimension — and that his counterpart on the other side is a hardened spy.

movies.title: Utopia
movies.synopsis: A group of strangers who come to possess a cult graphic novel are hunted by a shadowy organization known as The Network.

movies.title: The OA
movies.synopsis: A young woman who vanished seven years ago returns home with her sight restored and gathers a group of misfits to share her impossible story.

movies.title: Mindhunter
movies.synopsis: In the late 1970s, two FBI agents expand criminal science by interviewing imprisoned serial killers to understand how they think.

movies.title: Black Sails
movies.synopsis: Two decades before Treasure Island, Captain Flint and his pirates fight for the survival of New Providence Island.

movies.title: Halt and Catch Fire
movies.synopsis: Set in the 1980s personal computing boom, a visionary, an engineer and a prodigy take on the corporate giants that rule the industry.

movies.title: Rectify
movies.synopsis: After nineteen years on death row, Daniel Holden returns to his small Georgia hometown when new DNA evidence vacates his conviction.

movies.title: The Leftovers
movies.synopsis: Three years after two percent of the world's population inexplicably vanished, those left behind struggle to make sense of what happened.

movies.title: Dark
movies.synopsis: A missing child sets four families on a frantic hunt for answers as they unearth a mind-bending mystery that spans three generations.
